replication_study.hypothesis: Participants with higher realistic COVID-19 threat at their first survey (mean of covid_real1--covid_real5) will report higher negative affect one week later (sum of negative1--negative10), controlling for first-survey symbolic COVID-19 threat.

data_plan.source_type: Two-wave online survey data supplied with the replication materials.
data_plan.wave_or_subset: Responses after 2021-01-18 15:39:38, after the five documented duplicate-session exclusions, ID corrections/removal of unmatched blank IDs, and the documented attention screen; analysis uses participants with two retained responses.
data_plan.sample_size: The executable script calculates and records the final complete-case longitudinal-pair count in replication_results.json rather than hard-coding it.
data_plan.unit_of_analysis: Individual participant, represented once in the paired longitudinal regression.
data_plan.access_details: Data are supplied locally in task_input/replication_data/.

qualification.explanation: This is a qualified replication dataset because it contains the same two-wave survey measures and a supplied analysis notebook that operationalizes the focal longitudinal model, while the retained observations form an independently analyzed sample from the original-paper sample described in post_registration.json.
qualification.similarity_to_original: The original study used longitudinal survey analyses of realistic COVID-19 threat and affect-related outcomes (post_registration.json). The supplied dataset contains five covid_real items, five covid_symbolic items, ten negative-affect items, participant IDs, and timestamps; Analysis_updated.Rmd explicitly specifies Negative.y ~ Realistic.x + Symbolic.x.
qualification.deviation_from_original: The original-paper summary describes March 2020 MTurk data and a longitudinal subset with earlier October 2019 data (post_registration.json). The supplied replication file has retained survey timestamps in January--February 2021 and its own documented cleaning rules (replication_data/Analysis_updated.Rmd), yielding a later, distinct sample.

data_plan.notes: The deidentified file includes a SHA-256 value for blank participant IDs. The supplied notebook identifies it and directs its removal, along with explicit session and attention-check exclusions.

planned_method.steps: Read the supplied CSV; apply the documented date, duplicate-session, participant-ID, and attention-check exclusions; score realistic and symbolic threat as five-item means and negative affect as a ten-item sum; order each participant's two retained responses by timestamp; regress T2 negative affect on T1 realistic and symbolic threat; save numerical and graphical outputs.
planned_method.models: Ordinary least squares regression, equivalent to the focal observed-variable path in the supplied SEM specification.
planned_method.outcome_variable: T2 negative affect (sum of negative1 through negative10).
planned_method.independent_variables: T1 realistic threat (mean of covid_real1 through covid_real5) and T1 symbolic threat (mean of covid_symbolic1 through covid_symbolic5).
planned_method.control_variables: T1 symbolic threat is included as the concurrent threat predictor, matching the supplied model. No additional controls are added because the focal supplied path specifies only these predictors.
planned_method.tools_software: Python 3 with pandas, NumPy, statsmodels, and matplotlib.

planned_estimation_and_test.estimation: Unstandardized OLS coefficient for T1 realistic threat, with standard error and 95% confidence interval.
planned_estimation_and_test.test: Two-sided t test of the realistic-threat coefficient within the OLS model.

planned_method.missing_data_handling: Scale scores use available-item means/sums as in Analysis_updated.Rmd. The focal model then uses listwise deletion for missing T1 threat or T2 negative-affect composites.
planned_method.multiple_testing_policy: No multiplicity correction: this replication evaluates one preregistered focal hypothesis.
planned_method.inference_criteria: Support requires a positive realistic-threat coefficient and two-sided p < 0.05.

files.run_replication.py: Executable analysis script. It reads the local deidentified survey CSV, applies the cleaning and scoring rules documented in Analysis_updated.Rmd, constructs chronological T1/T2 pairs, fits the focal OLS model, and writes JSON, CSV, and PNG results.

codebase.notes: Run from the workspace root with python run_replication.py. Input paths are relative; the script exits nonzero when required data, variables, or valid paired data are unavailable.

other: Other necessary software (e.g., git, make, wget)

analysis.instructions: Install requirements with pip install -r requirements.txt, then run python run_replication.py from the workspace root. Inspect replication_results.json for the focal coefficient and decision, regression_table.csv for all fitted coefficients, and coefficient_plot.png for the coefficient plot.
analysis.comparison_metrics: Compare the sign, unstandardized coefficient, p value, and 95% confidence interval of realistic threat predicting subsequent negative affect with the claimed original estimate (b = 4.02, p = 0.000).
